# Alinubx.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

Alinubx.sys exposes IOCTL 0x222024 which allows user-mode applications to terminate arbitrary processes from the kernel via ZwTerminateProcess. The IOCTL input buffer expects a structure containing the PID (DWORD) and an exit status code (DWORD). Abused by the Cruciferra MaaS loader to kill AV/EDR processes.
- **UUID**: 84a3007a-de5e-4622-bfc5-f05d927c3618
- **Created**: 2026-08-27
- **Author**: Jose Hernandez
- **Acknowledgement**: eSentire Threat Response Unit (TRU) | [@eSentire_TRU](https://twitter.com/@eSentire_TRU)
